title: Reaching a named-but-unvisited quest destination (the mere-stone, the king's causeway, Longacre Chapel, the Sump Camp) requires walking a real path through many small, similarly-worded filler rooms — 'travel to a known place' only lists rooms already visited, so the first trip into a new hold is pure trial-and-error backtracking rather than following the direction a hint gave.
